note: Assets the dispatch service may run a cycle for. v1 is paper only (PRD: no live bids), so every asset must have mode 'paper'. Copy this file and point DISPATCH_ASSETS_FILE at the copy to change it.

labels.power_mw: PROPOSED: the 10 MW pilot size of the PRD (a 10 MW site grosses about $294k a year at $29.4/kW-yr)
labels.energy_mwh: PROPOSED: 2 hours, the arena's grid battery
labels.rte: ASSUMPTION: 0.85 round trip, as DEFAULT_RTE and the research arena
labels.loss_side: ASSUMPTION: all losses on charging, as the research arena, so LP and DP cross-checks line up
labels.wear_usd_per_mwh: ASSUMPTION: $20 per MWh discharged, as DEFAULT_WEAR_USD_PER_MWH
labels.initial_soc_mwh: ASSUMPTION: the paper ledger starts half full; this energy costs nothing in the exposure measure
labels.exposure_cap_usd: ASSUMPTION: cost basis of the energy in the battery may not exceed $25,000, about $1,250 per MWh of capacity (the guard rejects a setpoint that would exceed it)

disclosure_note: Public batteries whose actual dispatch comes from ERCOT's 60-day SCED disclosure (D0's esr_sced dataset), for GET /attribution only. They are not paper assets: no cycle runs for them (POST /signal answers 404) and there is no ledger. price_hub is the hub whose real-time price stands in for the resource node.

labels.power_mw: REAL: maximum HSL in the disclosure (D1b, notes/d1b.md section 7)
labels.rte: DERIVED: round-trip efficiency from the energy balance of the whole period, losses on charging (0.901)
labels.aux_load_mw: DERIVED: standing station-service draw, minus the median telemetered output at a zero base point (0.4 MW)
labels.wear_usd_per_mwh: ASSUMPTION: $20 per MWh discharged, as the case study
labels.price_hub: PROXY: HB_SOUTH stands in for the node PAD1_ESS_RN (node minus hub: mean +$1.01, MAE $1.78 on the 7-day MIS window)
labels.first_day: REAL: the 42 operating days (1 Jul to 11 Aug 2026) of the 60-day disclosure that the lake holds
